title: Examination of party walls.
officialText:
Party walls shall be carefully examined by a competent person designated by the
permit holder to ascertain the condition and adequacy of the party wall prior to the placement of any material that will impose
a load upon such party wall. If the party wall is to be found to be in poor condition or inadequate to support the stored
material, no material shall be deposited on the floor until the party wall is shored or otherwise strengthened as determined by
a registered design professional to safely support such material.
